content_sections.heading: About NIH
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Homoeopathy is an autonomous institute of the Government of India under the Ministry of Ayush. Its headquarters are at Block-GE, Sector-III, Salt Lake, Kolkata-700106, and it has a satellite campus at Sector-A8, Chaudhary Ramdev Chowk, Narela, Delhi-110040. The notice is dated 23 November 2026 (F. No. A/33/2025-Oo_MemberAK-Part(1)/1460) and is signed by the Director, NIH, Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of Computer Applications such as MS-Word, MS-Excel and PowerPoint, etc. is essential. Candidates should be well conversant with Central Secretariat functions like drafting, noting, budget, office procedure etc. The 10 years of experience should be in the relevant field, with expertise in handling electrical system-related activities, tendering processes (GeM/CPP etc.), and procurement procedures in accordance with GFR and other relevant guidelines. The 10 years of experience should include expertise in dealing with construction-related activities, tendering process, GFR and procurement guidelines etc. For all three posts, the candidate should not be more than 64 years of age on the last date for receipt of application. The contract shall not be extended beyond 05 years after superannuation. A fixed monthly amount is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. It remains unchanged for the term of the contract, with no annual increment or percentage increase. No Dearness Allowance is allowed during the contract. A fixed Transport Allowance is paid as per DOE's OM No. 21/5/2017 – E.II(B) dated 07.07.2014: Rs. 3,600 for an appointee who drew pay in Level 8 at retirement, and Rs. 7,200 for Level 9 and above. No allowance such as HRA, residential accommodation, CGHS or medical reimbursement is admissible. The notice does not give the rupee amount of the monthly remuneration, as it depends on each appointee's last pay and pension. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: NIH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Engagement meets the requirement due to additional activities of a defined time frame. Areas: Establishment, Administration, Policy matters/Legislation, Parliamentary matters, Vigilance, RTI, Legal matters, New projects, and specialized subject areas. Any other assignments given by the Competent Authority from time to time. Oversee, assess and support the electrical systems across the building infrastructure, and verify that electrical installations are correctly implemented, meet safety and regulatory standards, and are ready for operational use. Final inspections, functional testing, code compliance checks, oversight of the official takeover process, and support during the defects liability period. Recommend energy-efficient solutions to improve performance and reduce operational costs for existing older buildings, and look over maintenance work. Additional activities of defined time frame, new projects and specialized subject areas. Any other assignments given by the Competent Authority from time to time. Expertise required for all construction and maintenance related activities, tendering process, GFR and procurement guidelines (GeM/CPP Portal), etc. at NIH, Kolkata, and NIH, Narela, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure for Consultant (Establishment): till 31/03/2027 or till regular appointment is made or until further orders, whichever is earlier. Tenure for Consultant (Electrical Engineer) and Consultant (Civil Engineer): till 31/03/2027 or until further orders, whichever is earlier. The term of engagement shall ordinarily be an initial period not exceeding one year, extendable by another one year. Beyond two years after superannuation, where adequate justification exists, it may be extended after a review of the task and performance, but not beyond five years after superannuation. The consultant's term runs from 1 April to 31 March of a financial year. For those engaged midway, the initial period is till 31 March of that year. The engagement is purely on contract basis and confers no right to regular appointment. It is not a case of re-employment, and the retired servant continues to draw pension and Dearness Relief on pension. Working hours: normal office timing; the consultant may be called on Saturday, Sunday or any holiday in case of urgency, with no extra remuneration. Attendance must be marked in AEBAS, failing which remuneration may be deducted. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service, during the contract year (April to March); it cannot be accumulated beyond a calendar year. Income Tax or any other tax is deducted at source as per Govt. instructions, with a TDS certificate issued.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: A filled-up application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I). Original and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents in support of eligibility, duly signed. One passport-size photograph. Self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications and experience certificates, as the Annexure-I form asks. A PH certificate, if the candidate answers yes to being physically handicapped on the form. The Annexure-I form asks for name, date of birth, age as on interview date, gender, nationality, religion, marital status, category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD), Aadhaar number, PAN number, PPO/LPC, languages known, communication and permanent addresses, telephone number, e-mail ID, educational details, employment details in chronological order (post at superannuation, employer, period, pay scale, pay level in 7th CPC, nature of job), bank name, IFSC code and branch name, details of courses, training and publications, previous consultancy, and a signed declaration.

faq.question: Q1. When is the NIH Kolkata walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21.12.2026 (21 December 2026) for all three Consultant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What are the interview timings and venue?
faq.answer: Consultant (Establishment) is 10:00 A.M. to 01:00 P.M.; Consultant (Electrical Engineer) and Consultant (Civil Engineer) are 02:00 P.M. to 05:00 P.M. The venue is NIH, Academic Building, Block GE, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata 700106.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 2 for Consultant (Establishment), 1 for Consultant (Electrical Engineer) and 1 for Consultant (Civil Engineer).

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for these Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Only Indian citizens who are retired Government servants can attend. Establishment needs retirement from Section Officer to Additional Secretary level or equivalent; the engineer posts need retirement from an engineering cadre equivalent to Level-8 of 7th CPC and above, plus 10 years' post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The candidate should not be more than 64 years of age on the last date for receipt of application. The contract shall not be extended beyond 05 years after superannuation.

faq.question: Q6. How is the pay fixed for retired employees?
faq.answer: A fixed monthly amount is arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at retirement. It stays unchanged during the contract, with no annual increment.

faq.question: Q7. Is Transport Allowance or HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Transport Allowance of Rs. 3,600 (Level 8 at retirement) or Rs. 7,200 (Level 9 and above) is paid. No Dearness Allowance, HRA, residential accommodation, CGHS or medical reimbursement is admissible.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the filled-up Annexure-I application, original and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents duly signed, and one passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is purely a contract engagement till 31/03/2027 or until further orders, whichever is earlier (Establishment: or till regular appointment is made), and confers no right to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Will NIH pay travel or stay expenses for the interview?
faq.answer: No. NIH Kolkata will not pay any TA/DA, local conveyance or boarding-lodging charges to applicants for attending the walk-in interview.
